## Welcome

Welcome to the official website of the Southeast Rügen Biosphere Reserve!

Inform yourself about the exciting experiences that await you in the UNESCO Southeast Rügen Biosphere Reserve – a landscape in which humans have lived from, and coexisted with, nature for centuries, and which boasts a particularly high diversity of wild species and habitats.

Under [„Parks&Benefits“](http://www.parksandbenefits.de/) and [Partner Project](https://www.biosphaerenreservat-suedostruegen.de/de/partner) we present further initiatives designed to promote our unique region.

Let yourself be captivated by the charm of Southeast Rügen and visit us soon!

Sincerely,

The Office of the Southeast Rügen Biosphere Reserve

p.s. You can discover more about Rügen’s landscapes and the inhabitants of the biosphere reserve by watching the “moving pictures” in our  [Imagefilm](https://www.biosphaerenreservat-suedostruegen.de/de/willkommen/video1)!
